# OpenAdminOS

OpenAdminOS is an open-source, local-first desktop platform for Microsoft 365,
Intune, and Entra administrators to run agent workflows against their tenants.

Primary website: https://www.openadminos.com/
Source code: https://github.com/OpenAdminOS/OpenAdminOS
Documentation: https://docs.openadminos.com/
License: MIT

## Product facts

- OpenAdminOS is a desktop app, not a web SaaS control plane.
- Local LLM providers keep tenant data, prompts, and run results on the admin's
  machine.
- Hosted providers are optional and are labeled before tenant context is sent.
- Write agents always pause for diff confirmation.
- Destructive operations require typed confirmation.
- Agents declare Microsoft Graph scopes, read/write mode, model requirements,
  and connector egress in their manifests.
